# Verified Glam Scanner

> AI beauty analysis from your selfie — face scores, symmetry, celebrity matches, and glow-up tips. Android app on Google Play; web scans at scanner.verifiedglam.com.

Verified Glam Scanner is a product from Verified Glam (https://verifiedglam.com). Upload a photo for personalized AI beauty insights. Not medical advice.
